## Projects

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects.jpg)

## Mode of Communication <br/> ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/FaceToFace.png){.logo} Face-to-face

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/FaceToFace.png){.logo} Dynamic Conversation

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>person-to-person, face-to-face, realtime, improvised</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><br/><small>picture in the head</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>dynamic sketching for evidence-backed show and tell</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicConversation-Bottom.jpg){width="100%"} ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicConversation-Top.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/FaceToFace.png){.logo} Dynamic Creative Play

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>casual, playful, realtime, improvised, shared experience</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>passive, non-creative, isolating, anti-social</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>everyone participates/sees/understands the same thing</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicCreativePlay.jpg){width="80%"}
::::

## Mode of Communication <br/> ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Presenting.png){.logo} Presenting

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Presenting.png){.logo} Dynamic Presentation

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>person-to-group, realtime, prepared outline but improvised details</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>flexible blackboard or scripted static slides</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>sketch from scratch evidence-backed dynamic representations</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicPresentation.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Presenting.png){.logo} Dynamic Stage

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>spatial environment in which a presentation takes place</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>presentation material without stage design vs play and set</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>mapping between concept/physical spaces, human-scale representations, layout is outline</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicStage.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## Mode of Communication <br/> ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Reading.png){.logo} Reading

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Reading.png){.logo} Dynamic Reading

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>media-to-person, solitary, deliberate, prolonged, contemplative</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>concepts represented with words, mass-produced, one-size-fits-all</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>multi-channel, skimmable, transformable, explorable, context-sensitive, interrogable</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicReading-Bottom.jpg){width="40%"} ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicReading-Middle.jpg){width="40%"} ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicReading-Top.jpg){width="40%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Reading.png){.logo} Dynamic Spatial Media

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>media-to-person, personal,prolonged, contemplative — but human-scale, and experienced with the body</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>rectangular representations, focal vision, flat, intangible, hands neglected</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>Spatial textbooks, published and downloaded</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicSpatialMedia.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## Mode of Communication <br/> ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Browsing.png){.logo} Browsing, discovering, connecting

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Browsing.png){.logo} Dynamic Library

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>walkable environment for browsing and discovering knowledge</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>layouts of shelves of spines and books of papers conveying poor information</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>dynamic, multi-channel, at all time/distance scales, with spatially-anchored overview and connections</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicLibrary.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Browsing.png){.logo} Research Gallery

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<!-- <li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small></small></li> -->

<li><b>Today:</b><small>prior work displayed in space, less to learn than website/papers</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>intellectual environnment, physical presence, immersed, connections, space is a form of publication</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/ResearchGallery.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Browsing.png){.logo} Representation Gallery

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<!-- <li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small></small></li> -->

<li><b>Today:</b><small>design of visualization and programming languages, but not of representations</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>dynamic representations, for generalization/instantiation/analogy on corpus of ideas</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/RepresentationGallery.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## Mode of Communication <br/> ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Writing.png){.logo} Writing

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Writing.png){.logo} Dynamic Authoring

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>person-to-media, deliberate, prolonged</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>materials are static/manipulated or dynamic/scripted</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>directly manipulate representations of behavior and data</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicAuthoring.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## Mode of Communication <br/> ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Creating.png){.logo} Creating new knowledge

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Creating.png){.logo} Dynamic Mathematics

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>set of tools for modeling physical systems, in order to understand, predict, and design them</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>opaque representations, blind manipulation</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>evocative multimodal representations</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicMathematics.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Creating.png){.logo} Dynamic Objects To Think With

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>representation that’s designed to be inspected and manipulated with the hands</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>flat and intangible, ink on paper or pixels on a screen</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>dynamic abstract/symbolic concepts felt and manipulated by the fingers</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicObjectsToThinkWith-Bottom.jpg){width="50%"} ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicObjectsToThinkWith-Top.jpg){width="50%"}
::::

## ![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/ModesCommunication/Creating.png){.logo} Dynamic Environments To Think With

:::: r-hstack
::: desc
<ul>

<li><b>Mode of communication:</b><small>representation that’s designed to be explored and manipulated with the body</small></li>

<li><b>Today:</b><small>static design environments, paper or screens, immobile</small></li>

<li><b>Vision:</b><small>human-scale spatial representations, physical tangible tools</small></li>

</ul>
:::

![](images/3rdparty/BretVictorResearchAgenda/Projects/DynamicEnvironmentsToThinkWith.jpg){width="100%"}
::::

## Our toolchain

- [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) or [VSCodium](https://vscodium.com/) plus extensions:
  - [Quarto](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto.git#main): to create **Interactive Presentations** and **Pitches** ([revealjs](https://revealjs.com)) from Markdown.
  - [C/C++](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-cpptools) PLUS [extra compiler installation](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-cpptools#overview-and-tutorials) needed for the ([*Touch*](lecture-touch.html): Haptics) **Studio**.
  - [LTeX+](https://github.com/ltex-plus/vscode-ltex-plus.git): grammar/spell checking using LanguageTool.
- Git, [GitHub](https://github.com/) (Pages)
